binding.title: Bind a temperature sensor to TRVs
binding.description: The first picker is the temperature sensor the TRVs should follow; the second is one or more TRVs to drive. Both must already be commissioned to Matter.

data_description.sensor_device: The Matter device whose temperature reading the thermostats should follow.
data_description.trv_devices: One or more Matter thermostats (TRVs) that should use this sensor's reading.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the binding
reconfigure.description: Update the sensor and/or the TRV list. The changes are re-applied and verified.

error.legacy_server: The server is a legacy python-matter-server. Update to the Matter Server add-on 9.x or newer.
error.invalid_sensor: The selected device does not expose a Matter temperature measurement cluster.
error.invalid_trv: These devices do not expose a Matter thermostat cluster: {devices}.

device_missing.title: Bound Matter device no longer exists

init.title: Remove this binding?
init.description: This removes the binding entry {binding_name} and its entities from Home Assistant. Matter bindings on the devices themselves are not changed.

repair_failed.title: Binding repair keeps failing
repair_failed.description: The binding for {device_name} could not be repaired after {attempts} attempts. Check the device, the Matter network, and the Matter server.

repair.name: Repair bindings
repair.description: Runs an immediate verify-and-repair cycle for the selected binding device.
